background: ASAUD was established in 2015 by a group of dedicated actuarial science students who recognized the need for a platform to support their academic journey and professional development. What started as a small study group of 15 students has grown into a vibrant community of over 500 members.
overview: Over the years, ASAUD has evolved from a basic study group into a fully-fledged student association with strong industry partnerships, a comprehensive resource library, and a track record of producing successful actuarial professionals.

timeline.title: Association Established
timeline.description: ASAUD was officially formed with 15 founding members and the first leadership team.

timeline.title: First Career Fair
timeline.description: Organized the inaugural actuarial career fair with 5 companies participating.

timeline.title: Study Materials Library
timeline.description: Launched the first centralized study materials collection for all year levels.

timeline.title: Website Launch
timeline.description: Launched the first ASAUD website to centralize resources and announcements.

timeline.title: Industry Partnerships
timeline.description: Established formal partnerships with 3 major insurance companies.

timeline.title: Mentorship Program
timeline.description: Launched structured mentorship program connecting students with industry professionals.

timeline.title: Membership Milestone
timeline.description: Reached 500+ active members across the university.

timeline.title: Data & Projects Hub
timeline.description: Introduced datasets and student project showcases for practical learning.

timeline.title: Digital Transformation
timeline.description: Launched modern website with comprehensive resources and interactive features.

achievements.title: 500+ Active Members
achievements.description: Building a thriving community of actuarial science students across all year levels.

achievements.title: 10+ Industry Partners
achievements.description: Collaborating with leading insurance, pension, and financial institutions.

achievements.title: 50+ Internships Facilitated
achievements.description: Helping students secure internships through our network and mentorship.

achievements.title: 100+ Professional Exams Passed
achievements.description: Supporting students in passing professional actuarial examinations.
